scenes.title: Talking mate
scenes.caption: Speak to firstmate, and hear it answer.
scenes.say: Ever wanted to talk to your first mate out loud? Here is how the talking version works, and what it costs.

scenes.title: Why Amazon
scenes.caption: Firstmate's makers chose Amazon's Nova Sonic.
scenes.say: Firstmate's makers picked Amazon, not the mate. Nova Sonic is one model that hears your voice and speaks the answer, all in one go.

scenes.title: Fast
scenes.caption: First words arrive in about 1.2 seconds.
scenes.say: Sound streams both ways while you are still talking. So the first words of the answer arrive in about one point two seconds.

scenes.title: How it joins
scenes.caption: Laptop to secure tunnel to PC to Amazon.
scenes.say: Your laptop records and plays the sound. A secure tunnel carries it to the PC, which talks to Amazon. Your laptop never holds an Amazon password.

scenes.title: Two tools
scenes.caption: It reads numbers only, and drops work in an inbox.
scenes.say: Amazon's model gets two tools. One reads numbers, never names. The other drops work in the inbox. It can never change a project itself.

scenes.title: Not yet
scenes.caption: Hold a key to talk. No memory. No cutting in.
scenes.say: It has limits for now. You hold a key to talk, every question starts fresh, and you cannot cut in while it speaks.

scenes.title: The cost
scenes.caption: Likely a pound or two a month.
scenes.say: Speaking every message would be about five pounds a month. At today's busy pace, about nine. You would only speak some, so most likely a pound or two.

scenes.title: Your pick
scenes.caption: Tell me A, B, or both.
scenes.say: B needs your own Amazon account and a small install, in Amazon's voice. A is short answers in Peter's voice, free, about an hour. A, B, or both?
